clue.text: The county for deer

definitions.meaning: The usual short name of Buckinghamshire, an English county west of London
male deer are called ...

explanation.surface: A question about which shire is the one to go to for deer.
explanation.definitionFit: Bucks abbreviates Buckinghamshire, a home county, and stags or male deer are bucks.

clue.text: Raised and raised the question

definitions.meaning: a child raised by parents has been reared
a topic mentioned in conversation has been introduced

explanation.definitionFit: To be reared is to be brought up, and to bring up a matter is to mention or introduce it.

clue.text: Hoot in case it is the guard's van

indicators.note: the word in places the jeer inside the container word

parts.note: taken as written
a hoot of derision is a boo

explanation.surface: Someone hoots in case a railway guard's van passes by.
explanation.definitionFit: A caboose is the American name for the railway brake van at the rear of a freight train, where the guard rode.

clue.text: American girls turn over the cinders

indicators.note: turning over a word read downwards flips it so it reads from the bottom up

parts.note: gals is an American colloquial word for girls

explanation.surface: Some young American women overturn a heap of cinders.
explanation.definitionFit: Slag is the stony waste left after smelting, much like cinders or clinker.

clue.text: Rotten whisky produced ill feeling

parts.note: rotten fruit is bad
whisky is an example of a spirit, a distilled drink

explanation.surface: A dreadful whisky caused resentment among the drinkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad spirit is resentment or hostility, a synonym of ill feeling.

clue.text: Some ability is needed for a technical diploma maybe

definitions.meaning: a measure of competence or expertise
read whimsically as a qualification awarded for craft expertise, a certificate in competence

explanation.definitionFit: A certain level of competence is a degree of skill, and a qualification in a craft could jokingly be called a degree in that expertise.

clue.text: Advertisement which is soft on the ear

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical abbreviation for soft
lug is a colloquial word for ear

explanation.surface: An advert that sounds gentle to the listener.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts P above LUG.
explanation.definitionFit: A plug is a piece of publicity, a favourable mention promoting a product.

clue.text: Gaunt symbol of the Labour Party

definitions.text: Gaunt symbol of the Labour Party

parts.words: Gaunt symbol of the Labour Party
parts.note: John of Gaunt was Duke of Lancaster, whose house badge was a flower of one colour; the same flower is the emblem the British Labour Party adopted in the 1980s

explanation.surface: A thin, haggard emblem for a political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gaunt' looks like 'thin' but is John of Gaunt, father of the Lancastrian kings.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lancastrian badge in the Wars of the Roses was this flower, and Labour's logo is the same bloom.

clue.text: Stay smeared with pitch

definitions.meaning: to stay is to linger or remain
covered in tar or a similar black sticky substance

explanation.definitionFit: To tarry is to linger, and something coated with tar is tarry.

clue.text: Having embarked on a career as a executive director

definitions.meaning: aboard a ship or plane

definitions.text: on a career as a executive director
definitions.meaning: serving as a member of a company's governing body

explanation.definitionFit: Passengers who have embarked are aboard, and a director sits on the company's board.

clue.text: Run with assistance of an extra large meal

parts.note: to double is to run fast, as in 'at the double'
helping means giving assistance

explanation.surface: Someone runs with help towards a huge dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A second or twice-sized portion of food is a double helping.

clue.text: Sink all one's money in a disastrous involvement?

definitions.meaning: to sink is to go beneath the surface

definitions.text: all one's money in a disastrous involvement?
definitions.meaning: losing everything in a failed venture, collapsing into bankruptcy

explanation.definitionFit: A ship that founders goes beneath the waves, and a business that fails is said to fold or collapse in the same words.

clue.text: The deity encompasseth nothing but virtue

indicators.note: an archaic word for surrounds, so the deity's word goes around the next piece

parts.note: the deity is God
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Biblical phrasing: the Lord contains only goodness.
explanation.definitionFit: Good as a noun means moral excellence or righteousness.

clue.text: Crude remedy worked!

indicators.note: worked means manipulated or reshaped, so the letters of the first word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rough-and-ready treatment proved effective.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient helped by a successful treatment is healed or made well again.

clue.text: £25 bet on a young horse

definitions.meaning: British betting slang for a stake of twenty-five pounds
a small horse, here taken loosely as a foal

explanation.definitionFit: In British slang a pony is twenty-five pounds, and the word also names a small horse.

clue.text: What the dissectionist did when emotionally distressed

definitions.meaning: an anatomist slices a body into pieces
upset or hurt

explanation.definitionFit: A dissector carves a specimen into pieces, and someone upset is described as distraught in this phrase.

clue.text: Note that can be read back

indicators.note: reading the answer backwards gives the same letters, so it is a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A message that is legible in reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a musical note lasting half a semibreve.

clue.text: Robespierre's proposal for ending parliamentary debate

definitions.meaning: the beheading machine of the French Revolutionary Terror that Robespierre championed
a UK parliamentary motion that sets a timetable and cuts discussion short

explanation.definitionFit: The French Revolutionary beheading device shares its name with the Commons procedure limiting time for debating a bill.

clue.text: What ranchers do to check the situation regularly

definitions.meaning: ranchers look after and maintain herds of cattle
to monitor matters, as in keeping track of supplies

explanation.definitionFit: Ranchers hold livestock, and to take stock is to review a situation, extended here to holding an inventory.

clue.text: Guess tough times are jittery

indicators.note: jittery means nervous and shaky, so the preceding letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone predicts that hard times ahead are making people nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough estimate is an approximate calculation, a guess.

clue.text: Drink up just the same

indicators.note: in a down light, read upwards the letters are unchanged, so the word is a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Drink up all the same.
explanation.definitionFit: A reviver is a stimulating drink, a pick-me-up.

clue.text: A wild goat swallows it in a wild manner

indicators.note: one piece takes another inside it, as a mouth swallows food
wild means uncontrolled, so the letters of goat are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An untamed goat gulps something down frantically.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a goat eating something; in fact 'A' is just the letter, and 'wild' is the scramble signal acting only on the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitato is a musical direction meaning to play in an agitated, restless way.

clue.text: Fijian capital US turned over to one of its states

indicators.note: turned over means flipped, so the two letters read backwards

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for Virginia, one of the United States

explanation.surface: The United States hands the Fijian capital to one of its own states.
explanation.definitionFit: Suva is the capital city of Fiji, on the island of Viti Levu.

clue.text: Fires back with a short line added to a letter

definitions.text: a short line added to a letter

indicators.note: back means the word is read in reverse

explanation.surface: Someone shoots back with a short line attached to a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A serif is the small stroke finishing the strokes of a printed character.

clue.text: Everyone back home is exhausted

parts.note: all means everyone
someone who is back home is in

explanation.surface: When everyone gets home they are worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: All in is a colloquial phrase meaning completely tired, worn out.

clue.text: No hit when it comes to the marriage stakes

definitions.meaning: a failure to strike the target

definitions.text: when it comes to the marriage stakes
definitions.meaning: the title for an unmarried woman

explanation.definitionFit: A shot that fails to strike is a miss, and the same word is the courtesy title for an unwed woman.

clue.text: You don't say so to someone you wish to stop

definitions.text: You don't say so to someone you wish to stop

parts.words: You don't say so to someone you wish to stop
parts.note: a phrase of encouragement urging someone to continue, which is the last thing to say to anyone you want to halt; it is also an exclamation of disbelief like you don't say

explanation.surface: Advice on what not to say to a person you want to stop.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase urges continuation, so it is the opposite of a call to halt.

clue.text: Responsibility and where it lies if it is ours

definitions.meaning: a burden or duty

definitions.text: where it lies if it is ours
definitions.meaning: if the burden is ours, it rests upon us

explanation.definitionFit: An onus is a duty or burden, and read as two words the answer says it rests upon us.

clue.text: Viol air composed in an Italian restaurant

indicators.note: composed means put together or arranged, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A tune for viol written in an Italian restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description of what is found on the menu in an Italian restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli are small filled pasta parcels, a classic dish served in Italian trattorias.

clue.text: Well past desire to have an attempt

parts.note: to long is to desire
an is the indefinite article, A
a go is an attempt

explanation.surface: Someone past their prime still wants to try.
explanation.definitionFit: Long ago means in the distant past, well before now.

clue.text: Sounds like what the jouster did for a couple of weeks

indicators.note: sounds like says the following phrase is spoken to give the answer

parts.note: a jouster fought, as a mounted knight, so the phrase is fought knight

explanation.surface: A jouster competed for two weeks.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortnight is a period of fourteen days.

clue.text: It makes one's hair stand on end-a mass of hair

definitions.text: It makes one's hair stand on end
definitions.meaning: a sudden fright
a thick bushy head of hair

explanation.definitionFit: A fright is a shock, and a thick tangle of hair is a shock of hair.
